messages:
sophie: quick sync — attaching updated PRD draft for the adaptive fallback + rerank thresholding behavior across chat/completions/embeddings. want to align on acceptance criteria and rollout gating before i convert to RFC.

ajay: uploaded, taking a look now. is the plan to expose the fallback tier as an explicit policy field in the API or as a control-plane only knob?

sophie: good q. control-plane knob for Dedicated/Private (so infra can override), and an opt-in per-request `fallback_policy` for hosted customers (defaults kept conservative).

maria: for hosted opt-in shape, propose `fallback_policy: { tier: "compat"|"fast"|"cheap", threshold: 0.8 }` — threshold is score cutoff from reranker. if below, route to cheaper model.

leo: can we avoid breaking existing clients? if we add `fallback_policy` as optional field it's fine. need to document default behavior and existing implicit fallback (none).

sophie: exactly. default: `null` (no fallback). also adding server-side feature flag `adaptive_fallback_v1` for staged rollout.

tomas: edge cases: what about streaming chat responses with rerank? if we rerank mid-stream it could change prefix cache expectations. recommend only applying rerank at response boundary for streaming, and set `apply_rerank_at: "turn_end"|"response_end"` default `response_end`.

ajay: agree — also add acceptance test: stream with partial tokens, validate no duplicate tokens after fallback.

maria: metrics we need: fallbacks/sec, fallback latency delta, request error rate by tier, rerank precision @K, and U-curve of cost per 1k tokens. capture both pre- and post-fallback distributions.

sophie: acceptance criteria draft (short):
- API: hosted: optional `fallback_policy` as above, control-plane override for Dedicated/Private.
- Correctness: no truncated/duplicated tokens for streamed responses.
- Quality: reranker precision@5 >= 0.90 on internal eval set OR fallback disabled.
- Performance: p95 latency increase <= 12% when fallback enabled for same QPS.
- Safety: fallback models have same content filters; any deviation must trigger `safety_fallback_block=true`.

leo: can we add a small `fallback_debug` flag that returns which tier served and final rerank score (only in dev orgs)? helps investigating customer reports.

sophie: yes — dev-only `x-dev-fallback-debug=true` header supported, returns `x-fallback-meta` in response. document in console.

tomas: rollout plan suggestion: canary to 5% orgs (dev-only), smoke tests for stream/dedicated, then 25%, then full. each step gated by no >0.5% error bump and rerank precision hold.

maria: what about cost control? default `cheap` tier should have automatic token cap per-minute for trial orgs. include quota rules in console.

ajay: implementation notes for eng-runtime: need deterministic kernel selection when switching models mid-request; cache eviction at switch boundary; KV cache prefix replay for response continuity. i'll write a short infra ticket.

sophie: thanks. i'll update PRD with these acceptance bullets and add the `fallback_policy` JSON schema sample.

sophie: sample request (in PRD):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-rlm-1",
  "messages": [...],
  "fallback_policy": {"tier":"cheap","threshold":0.75},
  "top_p": 0.95
}
```

leo: small UX ask — console should show estimated cost delta when toggling a fallback policy in the model config preview.

maria: added to product tasks.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for next Tue 05:00 UTC for `adaptive_fallback_v1` to 5% hosted orgs.

ajay: noted. i'll draft infra PR and link. who owns the RFC?

sophie: i'll own the RFC writeup. ajay please pair on infra section, maria on metrics and evals, leo on docs. deadline: RFC ready for review by EOD Friday (1998770000).

leo: ack. :thumbsup:

sophie: thanks everyone — i'll push the PRD update in ~30m and ping again when RFC stub is ready. :eyes:
